cohort: 366 post-lower segment cesarean section (LSCS) mothers with delayed initiation of breastfeeding or subjective feelings of insufficient milk, recruited from a tertiary care teaching hospital in South India
finding: While not statistically significant at 3 or 6 months, oral Domperidone alongside effective breastfeeding counseling showed an increasing trend in the exclusive breastfeeding rate at 7 days and 6 months.
